'''Minnix''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[drug dealer]] based on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. He spent his [[Time/Legends|time]] in [[Kuzbar's Cantina]] waiting for clients to whom he sold common drugs and [[Tempest (spice)|tempest spice]]. Addicted to the spice himself, he purchased most of his supply from dealers in the [[Dark Melody]] [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafe]].
